invariants.rationale: The method accesses profile methods and assumes profile is non-null throughout.
Input partition path stat map is immediately used to access entrySet, requiring it to be non-null.
Output partition path stat map is always accessed to retrieve or update stats, so it must be non-null when used.
A map's size is always non-negative.
If output workload stats are maintained, all output partition keys should have been processed from input keys.
